enforce_lane.note: Recall of the same attack samples, through the same detection loop as metrics.recall, on an engine constructed with lane: 'enforce', which loads only maturity: stable rules: the lane README recommends when blocking is on. A match is not necessarily a block (src/verdict.ts decides that from severity and confidence), so this is an upper bound on what blocking stops. metrics.recall is the hunt lane (the engine default, every maturity). Not a headline.
